text:
maya: Nightly perf dashboard alert: 99p latency on master jumped ~30% vs yesterday for our small prompt workload. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/internal/dashboards/perf-alerts/1834567890 :alarm_clock: Kernel-selection metric (selector_time p99) spike.

deploy-bot: Alert created — perf-20260318-12 (severity: medium).

sam: Confirmed on my local perf-run too, selector_time up ~3-4ms p99. KV lookup ops also appear higher.

anya: Quick flamegraph from a repro run:

```
flamegraph top (sampled):
 - kernel_selector::score        45%  
 - kernel_dispatch              20%  
 - KVCache::lookup              15%  
 - batching::window_eval        10%  
 - other                        10%
```

maya: I'm starting a bisect now. Suspect merge 2a9f7b9 ('tweak selector heuristics + prefetch change') landed in last release window.

ralph: CI perf suite shows failures on ci/perf/kernel-select on ubuntu-x86 and macos-arm. Link: https://ci.redwood/job/perf/1834567890.

luke: Did a quick local revert of 2a9f7b9 and ran the small prompt harness — p99 returned to baseline (~back to yesterday). So 2a9f7b9 is the likely culprit.

sam: Can you paste the exact profiler stack you ran?

luke: pasted below (condensed):
```
# profiler snippet
kernel_selector::score() +0x120
kernel_selector::calculate_cost() +0x70
kernel_dispatch::choose() +0x1a8
KVCache::lookup() (more hits causing heavier scoring)
```

anya: Also noticed KV cache hit rate for the workload dropped from 87% -> 62% after that merge. Looks like the prefetch hint got effectively disabled for short-seqs. That increases selector invocations and thrashes KV state.

maya: Proposed plan: 1) open a revert PR for 2a9f7b9 as rollout blocker 2) run full ci/perf on revert branch 3) canary revert on dedicated pool 4) follow-up: add regression test for prefetch hint + tighten selector weight change.

ralph: I'll open the revert PR and add a perf test to ci/perf/kernel-select. tagging @eng-sre for canary scheduling.

eng-sre: Ack — canary slot requested for 09:00 PST, will monitor latency heatmap and KV hitrate.

sam: Minor runtime suggestion: clamp selector score delta to 0.2 in the interim so extreme weight changes don't cause oscillation. We can iterate after revert.

maya: Sounds good — include that in the revert PR as an optional patch. Any objections? :+1:

deploy-bot: Revert PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/4521 — title: Revert "tweak selector heuristics + prefetch". CI triggered.

ci-bot: ci/perf/kernel-select started for PR #4521 at 1834568002.

maya: Thanks everyone — assigning follow-ups: ralph (PR + perf test), anya (postmortem notes + KV metrics), sam (score clamp patch), eng-sre (canary monitoring). Will re-evaluate after CI results. :eyes:
